# The files that make up Wdf01000.sys in the TUR build: every kernel-mode
# source file of Microsoft's Windows-Driver-Frameworks (paths relative to
# src/framework/ of the pinned commit), except those noted, plus the
# stand-ins in compat/ (paths starting with compat/).
#
# Not built:
#   shared/object/dbgtrace.cpp  replaced by DoTraceLevelMessage in
#                               compat/tur-wdf-missing.cpp, which prints the
#                               WPP format strings safely
